name: Saudi Steel Pipes Company
summary: Saudi Steel Pipes Company engages in the manufacturing and distribution of steel pipes in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company offers welded steel pipes by high frequency induction welding and galvanizing, coating, threading, and bending of the pipes used in oil and gas, water, industrial, and construction sectors. It also produces ERW/HFI galvanized and threaded steel pipes, and seamless pipes; pipes with three-layer external coating by polyethylene and polypropylene, and epoxy coating; and bended pipes in various diameters and space frame, as well as submerged arc welded pipes.
